title: Visual QA procedure and evidence standard
summary: Write the procedure every gameplay, UI, and capture PR goes through before the Coordinator reviews it, and apply it to M0-UNITY-04 as the first live use.

acceptance_tests.test: qa/VISUAL_QA.md defines: per-PR-type checklists (gameplay, UI, capture), evidence naming (qa/evidence/<ticket>/<nn>-<what>.png, ≤ 2 MB), clip rules (≤ 30 s, attached to the PR, never committed), the reference-device Profiler screenshot requirement, the Design Skills §4 items QA re-checks, and the DEFECT issue flow with severities S1–S4.
The procedure is applied on M0-UNITY-04 and the evidence follows the naming rules.
A privacy line is part of every evidence set: no faces, addresses, documents, or screens with personal data.
